testimonials.heading: Players from across Syria making the move

1.quote: Used to waste hours coordinating matches on WhatsApp. Now I just open the app Sunday morning, book my spot in Damascus, and go. Simple.

2.quote: The waitlist is fair and transparent. Got promoted to my match in Aleppo within days. No more wondering if spots are actually available.

3.quote: Playing consistently in Homs finally pays off. I can track my stats match after match and watch myself improve. That motivation is real.
3.author: Ravi P., Homs

1.q: Do I need an account to browse matches?
1.a: Yes — booking is members-only, but creating an account takes under a minute. Just an email or phone number to get started.

2.a: If a match is full, you can join the waitlist with a prepaid hold equal to the match price. The moment a spot opens up, you're promoted automatically and your hold becomes your booking. If you never get promoted, or you cancel before the cutoff, the full amount is refunded to your wallet.

3.q: Can I get a refund if I can't make it?
3.a: Cancel before the club's cutoff window and your spot goes back into the pool for the next player. Match cancelled by the club? You're refunded automatically — money lands in your wallet within the same day.

4.q: How do I top up my wallet?
4.a: Once you're logged in, head to your wallet and pick a top-up amount. Payment runs through a secure provider — your card details never touch our servers.

5.q: Is this club running this whole thing?
5.a: Yes. SportBooker provides the platform, but the schedule, venues, pricing and rules are all owned by your club.
